title: Query explicit proposals independently from comparison newness
preconditions: Use WriteInventoryFixture with code-free job/queue, implemented store r3 with proposed r2 in history, implemented pipeline/report and two feature Items selecting pipeline and report; commit head and retain the pre-Saga baseline.

steps.action: Query inventory --intent proposed and --intent implemented --kind component.
steps.expected_result: Proposed includes job/queue and excludes implemented store; implemented Components include store/worker and exclude queue.

steps.action: Query inventory --new against the pre-Saga baseline, then against the current head.
steps.expected_result: All eight identities, including implemented definitions, are new against the absent baseline and none are new against head.

steps.action: Query inventory --feature for the Items' feature and inventory-uses for the job.
steps.expected_result: Feature reachability includes pipeline, store, worker, queue, report and job through declared pins; unrelated ERD is excluded; job uses include relationship destination and overlay.

expected_result: Feature reachability includes pipeline, store, worker, queue, report and job through declared pins; unrelated ERD is excluded; job uses include relationship destination and overlay.
